newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - AFTERNOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 31.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - AFTERNOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 31.

text.p: Here are the main headlines from the afternoon report of Lithuania's M1 Plus radio station. Reuters has not confirmed these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- As of August 1, the official reserves of the central bank will reach a record $1.35 billion. Since July 1, foreign exchange, gold and special drawing rights have increased by $195 million.

- Lithuania will issue one-litas gold coins to commemorate the 75th anniversary of the Bank of Lithuania and the national currency, the litas. The coins will cost 500 litas and will be released at the end of September.
